title: Type V construction.
officialText:
Foam plastic spray applied to a sill plate and header of Type V construction is permitted
without a thermal barrier, subject to all of the following:
1. The maximum thickness of the foam plastic shall be 3¼-inches (82.6 mm).
2. The density of the foam plastic shall be in the range of 1.5 to 2.0 pcf (24 to 32 kg/m3).
3. The foam plastic shall have a flame spread index of 25 or less and an accompanying smoke-developed index of 450 or
less when tested in accordance with ASTM E 84 or UL 723.
